items.title: Unit 7 · Lesson 1 story
items.storyText:
It's Billy's birthday tomorrow. Let's buy presents. What does he like? He likes trains and cars.

I like these balloons. No. Billy doesn't like balloons. He's scared of balloons.

He likes chocolate. OK.

Billy is asleep now. Put his presents here. It's a surprise! Good idea, Mum.

Mum, Dad. Someone's in the living room!

Oh Billy! It's five o'clock! Thank you for my presents. I'm three now!

Draw and colour a picture on the front of the card. Now open the card. Draw a picture of you with a big smile. Write in the card, 'Dear Mum, Thank you for everything you do for me.' Then write your name. Give the card to your mum.
